title: 5 signs your dog needs a wellness check this season
excerpt: From appetite changes to coat quality — learn when to book a routine visit before small issues become urgent.
content: Seasonal changes can affect your dog's energy, skin, and digestion. Watch for appetite shifts, coat dullness, lethargy, weight change, or repeated scratching. A routine wellness visit helps catch problems early and keeps vaccines up to date.
author: Dr. Sarah Johnson

title: Indoor cats: vaccination schedules that actually work
excerpt: Even stay-at-home cats benefit from core vaccines. We break down timing, boosters, and what to expect at the clinic.
content: Indoor cats still need protection against diseases that can enter the home on clothing or other pets. Your vet will recommend a core schedule for FVRCP and rabies, with boosters based on age and lifestyle.
author: Dr. Emily Chen

title: Grooming at home vs. professional grooming
excerpt: Brushing, nail trims, and ear care — when DIY is enough and when to bring your pet in for a full groom.
content: Regular brushing and nail trims at home are great for bonding. Professional grooming is best for matting, breed-specific cuts, anal gland care, and pets that are anxious or difficult to handle safely at home.
author: Jessica Williams

title: What to pack for your pet's first daycare visit
excerpt: Vaccination records, comfort items, and feeding notes help our team give your pet a calm, happy day.
content: Bring current vaccination records, any medications with instructions, a familiar blanket or toy, and clear feeding notes. Tell staff about triggers or separation anxiety so we can support your pet from arrival to pickup.
author: Amanda Brooks

title: 10 essential tips for first-time pet owners
excerpt: Starting your journey as a pet parent? These essential tips will help you provide the best care from day one.
content: Choose a vet before you need one, pet-proof your home, establish feeding and walk routines, and schedule a first wellness exam within the first week. Socialization and positive training start early.
author: Mike Peterson

title: Understanding your cat's behavior
excerpt: Learn to decode body language and understand what your feline friend is trying to tell you.
content: Tail position, ear angle, and vocalizations all signal mood. Sudden hiding or litter-box changes can mean stress or illness — book a checkup if behavior shifts last more than a few days.
author: Dr. Emily Chen

title: The ultimate guide to pet nutrition
excerpt: Explore how to choose the best diet for your companion based on age, species, and health needs.
content: Look for complete diets labeled for your pet's life stage. Avoid toxic human foods, measure portions, and ask your vet before switching brands or trying homemade diets.
author: Jessica Williams

title: Common health issues in senior pets
excerpt: Learn about challenges in older pets and how to keep them comfortable at home.
content: Arthritis, dental disease, and kidney issues are common in seniors. Twice-yearly exams, joint support, and dental care improve quality of life.
author: Dr. Robert Martinez

title: The benefits of regular vet checkups
excerpt: Prevention is better than cure. Learn why routine visits matter for long-term health.
content: Annual or bi-annual exams detect issues before symptoms appear. Vaccines, parasite prevention, and blood work are tailored to your pet's age and risk factors.
author: Dr. Lisa Anderson
